exact.主 .tex 中没有找到 abstract 环境或 Abstract 章节。: No abstract environment or Abstract section in the main .tex.
exact.论文源码中还没有 figure 或 table 环境。: The paper has no figure or table environments yet.
exact.编译完成，但没有找到图表所在的页面。: Compiled, but the pages of the figures and tables could not be found.
exact.找不到这个图表，请刷新后重试。: That figure or table was not found. Refresh and try again.
exact.请写下给 AI 的图表调整说明（不超过 4000 字）。: Write your instruction for the AI (up to 4000 characters).
exact.这条指令已处理或已撤回。: This instruction was already handled or withdrawn.
exact.项目中没有找到 LaTeX 主文件。: No main LaTeX file found in the project.
exact.responses 中的 request 应为尚未处理的图表指令编号。: Each request in responses must be the number of an open figure/table instruction.
exact.请为每条图表指令写下处理说明（不超过 2000 字）。: Explain how you handled each instruction (up to 2000 characters).
exact.paper.md 的 Paperroom 大纲格式有改动。请保留原文并复原大纲中: The Paperroom outline format in paper.md was altered. Keep the text and restore the outline's headings, numbering and paperroom comments.
exact.paper.md 是符号链接。请在项目根目录使用普通 Markdown 文件。: paper.md is a symbolic link. Use a regular Markdown file in the project root.
exact.请填写至少一个大纲条目。: Fill in at least one outline item.
exact.paper.md 已由其他编辑器修改，请重新载入。: paper.md was changed by another editor. Please reload.
exact.大纲已更新，请重新载入后提交。: The outline was updated. Reload, then submit.
exact.研究问题和证据概述必须是文字。: The research question and evidence must be text.
exact.请先提供 research question 与已有实验或证据概述。: Provide the research question and a summary of evidence first.
exact.请用章节 ID 列出需要复核的章节。: List the sections to recheck by ID.
exact.章节名称请使用一行。: Keep section titles on one line.
exact.请先复核这一节的段落大纲。: Recheck this section's paragraph plan first.
exact.这段的逐句意图尚待作者填写或复核。: This paragraph's sentence intents still need the author.
exact.本节有段落尚待作者填写或复核逐句意图。: Some paragraphs in this section still need the author's sentence intents.
exact.一次最多保存 100 页节选。: At most 100 pages can be saved at once.
exact.没有找到 Tectonic 或 pdfLaTeX。请安装其一，或传入同一版本已编: Neither Tectonic nor pdfLaTeX was found. Install one, or pass a PDF compiled from the same version (--pdf on the command line).
exact.无法确定本节所在页码，请传入已编译 PDF 和本节页码。: Could not determine this section's pages. Pass a compiled PDF and the section's pages.
exact.PDF 须大于零且不超过 32 MiB。: The PDF must be non-empty and 32 MiB or less.
exact.没有生成指定的页面，请核对 PDF 页码。: The requested pages were not produced. Check the PDF pages.
exact.节选文件过大，请缩小页码范围。: The excerpt is too large. Narrow the page range.
exact.生成节选图片需要 Poppler 的 pdftoppm，macOS 使用系统自带: Page images need Poppler's pdftoppm, or PDFKit on macOS.
exact.无法读取 PDF 或节选页码超出范围。: Cannot read the PDF, or the pages are out of range.
exact.请指定本节页码，一次最多保存 100 页。: Give the section's pages; at most 100 pages can be saved at once.
exact.读取时 PDF 已更新，请重新选择文件。: The PDF changed while reading. Choose it again.
exact.请从本机的 Paperroom 页面提交。: Submit from the local Paperroom page.
exact.表单为空或超过 1 MiB。: The form is empty or larger than 1 MiB.
exact.此版本未保存所请求的排版文件。: This version has no saved file of that kind.
exact.这页审阅图不存在。: That review page does not exist.
exact.请从本机的时间记录页面导出。: Export from the local writing log page.
exact.这次编译没有保存所请求的页面。: This build has no such page.
exact.所选章节不存在，请刷新工作区。: The selected section no longer exists. Refresh the workspace.
exact.所选段落不属于当前章节。: The selected paragraph does not belong to this section.
exact.作者可在写作间的「图表与数据」中查看。: The author can view them under Figures & data in the workspace.
exact.未找到对应事件，请刷新记录。: Record not found. Refresh the log.
exact.记录已变动，请刷新时间记录。: The record changed. Refresh the log.
exact.无法读取回执中签署的 UTC 时间。: Cannot read the signed UTC time in the receipt.
exact.时间戳机构须使用不含账号密码的 HTTPS 地址。: The timestamp authority must use an HTTPS address without credentials.
exact.记录摘要必须为 SHA-256。: The record digest must be SHA-256.
exact.时间戳核验需要 OpenSSL 的 ts 命令。: Timestamp verification needs OpenSSL's ts command.
exact.时间戳处理失败，请检查回执、记录摘要、请求随机数与受信 CA 证书。: Timestamp processing failed. Check the receipt, digest, nonce and trusted CA certificate.
exact.未找到系统根证书，请配置 PAPERROOM_TSA_CA_FILE。: No system root certificates found. Set PAPERROOM_TSA_CA_FILE.
exact.时间戳请求格式错误或过大。: The timestamp request is malformed or too large.
exact.时间戳回执格式错误或过大。: The timestamp receipt is malformed or too large.
exact.时间戳回执超过 1 MiB。: The timestamp receipt is larger than 1 MiB.
exact.时间戳机构的 HTTPS 地址或端口格式错误。: The timestamp authority's HTTPS address or port is malformed.
exact.本机时间戳核验程序未能完成。: Local timestamp verification did not finish.
exact.找不到指定的时间戳 CA 证书文件。: The timestamp CA certificate file was not found.
exact.时间戳请求缺少 SHA-256 或随机数。: The timestamp request lacks SHA-256 or a nonce.
exact.无法连接时间戳机构，本机写作记录可稍后再验证。: Cannot reach the timestamp authority; local records can be verified later.
exact.无法提取审阅 PDF 的文字。请安装 Poppler（pdftotext），或在: Cannot extract text from the review PDF. Install Poppler (pdftotext), or use PDFKit on macOS.
exact.无法读取审阅 PDF 的文字层，请检查 PDF 能否正常打开并选择文字。: Cannot read the review PDF's text layer. Check that the PDF opens and its text can be selected.
exact.这个阶段已经发生变化。请刷新页面或重新查看 status。: This stage has changed. Refresh the page or check status again.
exact.请先用自己的话写下本阶段的思路。: Write your thinking for this stage in your own words first.
exact.请提供刚刚讨论的句子安排。: Provide the sentence plan you just discussed.
exact.当前版本缺少 LaTeX 或审阅图片。: This version lacks LaTeX or review images.
exact.编译期间源文件已修改。请重新发布。: The source changed during compilation. Publish again.
exact.Paperroom 数据目录必须位于本论文项目内。: The Paperroom data folder must be inside this paper's project.
exact.请提供范围名称、正确的段落数和审稿条数。局部改写只处理一段。: Provide a scope name, paragraph count and number of review notes. A partial rewrite handles one paragraph.
exact.刚才的命令改动了 paper.md。请恢复命令执行前的内容。: The last command changed paper.md. Restore its content from before the command.
exact.刚才的命令写入了整段正文。: The last command wrote whole paragraphs.
exact.无法确定本节所在页码，请检查本节是否被条件编译或 \\includeonly 排: Could not determine this section's pages. Check whether a conditional or \includeonly leaves it out.
exact.这个文件的部分内容无法预览，已显示读到的行。: Part of this file cannot be previewed; the rows read so far are shown.
exact.这个文件的部分内容无法预览，已显示读到的行。（单个字段过长）: Part of this file cannot be previewed (a field is too long); the rows read so far are shown.
exact.未能读取图表状态，大纲、正文和审阅记录不受影响。: Could not read the figure and table status; outlines, prose and reviews are unaffected.
exact.请刷新页面，看过图表后再确认。: Refresh the page and look at the figure or table before confirming.
exact.这张图表的编译版本已变化，请刷新后再确认。: The compiled version of this figure or table has changed. Refresh and confirm again.
exact.章节安排可以在对话中和 AI 讨论后由 AI 草拟。读过后采用，或直接修改后保存: The AI can draft the sections after you discuss the structure in the chat. Read the draft, then adopt it, or edit and save it; each section's paragraph plan opens once adopted.
exact.AI 草拟的章节安排待你采用: Sections drafted by the AI, waiting for you to adopt
exact.下面的表单就是这份草稿。原样认可就点「采用」；改过再保存，同样算你采用。: The form below is the draft. If it is right as it stands, press Adopt; saving your edits counts as adopting too.
exact.还没有章节安排。可以在原对话中和 AI 讨论论文结构，请 AI 草拟；也可以在这: No sections yet. Discuss the paper's structure with the AI in the chat and ask it for a draft, or write them here yourself.
exact.这一节的章节安排由 AI 草拟，还没有采用。: This section was drafted by the AI and has not been adopted yet.
exact.在整篇大纲中读过 AI 草拟的章节和作用，采用或修改后，就可以写这一节的段落大纲: Read the sections and roles the AI drafted in the paper outline. Once you adopt or edit them, you can plan this section's paragraphs.
exact.这一节的章节安排还没有采用。: This section has not been adopted yet.
exact.仅供参考。段落安排请用你自己的话写。: For reference only. Write the paragraph plan in your own words.
exact.表单里有未保存的修改。保存修改同样算采用；或刷新页面放弃修改后再采用。: The form has unsaved edits. Saving them counts as adopting; or reload the page to discard them and then adopt.
exact.AI 给出了段落安排参考: AI left a reference for a paragraph plan
exact.请先在整篇大纲中采用这一节的章节安排。: Adopt this section in the paper outline first.
exact.reopen 应为章节 ID 列表。: reopen must be a list of section IDs.
exact.没有待采用的章节。: No sections are waiting to be adopted.
exact.请提供不超过 4000 字的参考。: Provide a reference of at most 4000 characters.
exact.请作者在写作间的整篇大纲中读过后采用。: Ask the author to read the paper outline in the workspace and adopt it.
exact.请撤回这些段落的改动，恢复命令执行前的内容。: Undo the changes to these paragraphs and restore their content from before the command.
exact.Paperroom 只拦截整段代写：小幅修改可以直接进行。请先请作者在写作间完成: Paperroom only stops whole-paragraph ghostwriting; small edits are fine. Ask the author to finish this paragraph's outline and sentence intents in the workspace (open_writing_workspace), then write it from those intents, or make only small edits.
exact.paper.md 保存作者的三级大纲，不能直接编辑。研究问题和证据请用 upda: paper.md holds the author's three-level outline and cannot be edited directly. Record the research question and evidence with update_research_assets; draft the sections with propose_paper_outline for the author to adopt; paragraph plans and sentence intents are written by the author in the workspace (open_writing_workspace).

patterns: ^这台电脑没有 LaTeX 编译器，也没有找到已编译的 (.+)。请先让 AI 编译论文，再保存版本；或安装编译器（brew install tectonic）。$
This computer has no LaTeX compiler and no compiled {1} was found. Ask the AI to compile the paper first, then save the version, or install a compiler (brew install tectonic).
^(.+) 比论文源码旧。请先让 AI 重新编译，再保存版本。$
{1} is older than the paper's source. Ask the AI to compile it again, then save the version.
The text is the same as in V{1}.
^版本已更新（还没有版本），请重新读取 workspace_status 后再保存。$
Versions have changed (none saved yet). Read workspace_status again before saving.
^版本已更新（最新是 V(\d+)），请重新读取 workspace_status 后再保存。$
Versions have changed (the latest is V{1}). Read workspace_status again before saving.
The background workspace did not start: {1}
^未能自动保存原稿版本 V0：(.+)$
Could not save the original as V0: {1}
^至少 (\d+) 条，随本版一起提交。$
At least {1}, submitted with this version.
^与上一版对照 · (\d+) 段有变化$
Compared with the previous version · {1} paragraphs changed
^本版改动了第 ([\d、]+) 段，移除了 (\d+) 段。其余段落与上一版相同，可以略读。$
This version changes paragraph {1} and removes {2}. The others are unchanged and can be skimmed.
^本版改动了第 ([\d、]+) 段。其余段落与上一版相同，可以略读。$
This version changes paragraph {1}. The others are unchanged and can be skimmed.
^更换(改前|改后|原稿|成稿)显示的版本$
^申请时，Paperroom 会将该条记录的加盐摘要发送给 (.+)。$
When you request one, Paperroom sends a salted digest of the record to {t1}.
^这一版至少需要 (\d+) 条针对具体位置的意见。$
This version needs at least {1} observations tied to specific places.
^移除这个章节及其已有段落？保存大纲后生效。$
Remove this section and its paragraphs? This takes effect when you save the outline.
^移除这(个章节|一段)？保存大纲后生效。$
Remove this item? This takes effect when you save the outline.
^确认本版通过？已写的 (\d+) 条意见会一并提交。之后 AI 可以继续定稿或进入下一节。$
Approve this version? Your {1} observations are submitted with it. The AI can then finalize it or move to the next section.
^(.*) 请刷新重试，已输入的草稿保存在本页。$
{t1} Refresh to retry; your drafts are kept on this page.
^源码中本节有 (\d+) 段，作者大纲有 (\d+) 段。请让两者按顺序一一对应：调整源码，或请作者修改段落大纲。$
The source has {1} paragraphs in this section and the author's plan has {2}. Make them match in order: adjust the source, or ask the author to change the paragraph plan.
^源码中本节有 (\d+) 段，作者大纲有 (\d+) 段（(.+)）。请让两者按顺序一一对应后再发布。$
The source has {1} paragraphs in this section and the author's plan has {2} ({3}). Make them match in order before publishing.
^源码中本节只有 (\d+) 段。请先把第 (\d+) 段写进源码（(.+) 之后），再登记。$
The source has only {1} paragraphs in this section. Write paragraph {2} into the source (after {3}) before registering it.
^正文以 \.tex 为准。请把这一段写进 (.+)，然后不带 text 重新登记。$
The .tex is the source of prose. Write this paragraph into {1}, then register it again without text.
^第 (\d+) 段（(.+)）尚未登记。请核对作者句意后调用 save_paragraph_draft。$
Paragraph {1} ({2}) is not registered. Check the author's intents, then call save_paragraph_draft.
^第 (\d+) 段（(.+)）登记后改写超过一半。请核对作者的逐句大纲，再用 save_paragraph_draft 重新登记这一段。$
Paragraph {1} ({2}) was more than half rewritten after registration. Check the author's sentence intents and register it again with save_paragraph_draft.
Choose a {1} file inside the project.
^请对上一版的 (\d+) 条审阅意见逐条回应（responses）：说明已修改、保留原文或有不同意见，并给出理由。$
Answer each of the {1} notes on the previous version (responses): changed, kept or discuss, with a reason.
Notes {1} have not been answered yet.
^responses 中的 note 应为 1 到 (\d+) 的意见序号。$
Each note in responses must be a note number from 1 to {1}.
^第 (\d+) 条意见回应了不止一次。$
Note {1} is answered more than once.
^这版至少需要 (\d+) 条审阅意见。$
This version needs at least {1} notes.
^项目中有多个主 \.tex（(.+)）。请用 bind_section_source 指定本节所在的主文件。$
The project has several main .tex files ({1}). Use bind_section_source to choose the one for this section.
^主 \.tex 中没有找到标题为「(.+)」的章节。新章节请先写入 \\section 标题，或用 bind_section_source 绑定。$
No section titled "{1}" in the main .tex. For a new section, write its \section heading first, or bind it with bind_section_source.
^主 \.tex 中没有找到\\label\{(.+)\}。新章节请先写入 \\section 标题，或用 bind_section_source 绑定。$
No \label{{1}} in the main .tex. For a new section, write its \section heading first, or bind it with bind_section_source.
^主 \.tex 中有多个「(.+)」章节，请用 bind_section_source 指定 label。$
The main .tex has several sections titled "{1}". Use bind_section_source with a label.
^第 (\d+) 条图表指令回应了不止一次。$
Figure/table instruction {1} is answered more than once.
The {t1} was not found. Please reload.
^请写至少 (\d+) 条各不相同的审稿想法。$
Write at least {1} distinct review thoughts.
^无法打开本机浏览器工作区：(.+)。可重新打开同一工作区。$
Could not open the local workspace in a browser: {1}. You can reopen the same workspace.
Could not save the original layout automatically: {t1}
^无法在本次审阅 PDF 中核实第 (\d+) 段的完整正文。.*$

Could not verify the full text of paragraph {1} in this review PDF. Check the physical pages and the PDF version so that the paragraph's start and end are included; equations, custom macros or missing text layers can also prevent verification.
^(.+) 是新写或改写超过一半的整段正文，但作者还没有写「(.+)」第 (\d+) 段的逐句意图。$
{1} is a new or more than half rewritten paragraph, but the author has not written the sentence intents for paragraph {3} of "{2}".
^(.+) 是新写或改写超过一半的整段正文，但作者的「(.+)」段落大纲中没有第 (\d+) 段。$
{1} is a new or more than half rewritten paragraph, but the author's plan for "{2}" has no paragraph {3}.
^(.+) 是新写或改写超过一半的整段正文，但「(.+)」不在作者的论文大纲里。$
{1} is a new or more than half rewritten paragraph, but "{2}" is not in the author's paper outline.
^(.+) 是新写或改写超过一半的整段正文，但作者大纲中的「(.+)」对应 (.+)，(.+) 里的这一节没有作者意图。$
{1} is a new or more than half rewritten paragraph, but "{2}" in the author's outline belongs to {3}; this section in {4} has no author intents.
^(.+) 是新写或改写超过一半的整段正文，但项目有多个主 \.tex，作者大纲中的「(.+)」还没有绑定主文件。$
{1} is a new or more than half rewritten paragraph, but the project has several main .tex files and "{2}" in the author's outline is not bound to one yet.
^(.+) 是新写或改写超过一半的整段正文，但作者还没有写论文大纲。$
{1} is a new or more than half rewritten paragraph, but the author has not written a paper outline yet.
^「(.+)」位于 (.+)，但主文件的 \\includeonly 没有包含它，编译结果里不会出现这一节。请在 \\includeonly 中加入该文件，或删除 \\includeonly 后重试。$
"{1}" is in {2}, but the main file's \includeonly leaves it out, so the compiled paper does not contain this section. Add the file to \includeonly, or remove \includeonly, and try again.
^(.+)没有出现在编译结果中，可能被 \\if 条件、注释环境或 \\includeonly 排除。请删除不会排版的段落，或改为确定会排版的写法后重试。$

{t1} did not appear in the compiled paper; an \if conditional, a comment environment or \includeonly may leave it out. Remove paragraphs that are not typeset, or write them so they are, and try again.
^「(.+)」已有作者写的段落大纲。删除或改动这一节会让作者重新确认段落和句意，请先征得作者同意，再把它的 ID 放进 reopen。$
"{1}" already has the author's paragraph plan. Removing or changing it makes the author confirm the paragraphs and intents again; ask the author first, then put its ID in reopen.
